meta.title: Yanyan toolkit
meta.description: Injects a context occupancy reading at the first step of every turn and reminds once per tier (handover, compact soon, nearly full), each tier once per session. A periodic clock line (YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm, with the current occupancy when readable) is appended every 6 hours by default and once at process start. Also reminds you to rotate to a new session on a chosen schedule (interval, weekly, or monthly), leaving a rotation marker line in the clock file. Every injection can be scoped per session (scopeSessions): leave it empty to reach all sessions, or list session ids or prefixes to inject only in matching sessions; the clock line is unaffected. Nothing is injected while occupancy is unavailable. Configure it under Settings, in the left navigation entry Yanyan toolkit — not on the plugin page.
